parameters.query:
select coalesce(
         (select json_build_object('id', id::text, 'status', status, 'category', category)
            from leads
           where email = $1),
         '{}'::json
       ) as existing

with updated as (
  update leads
     set submission_count = submission_count + 1,
         updated_at = now()
   where id = $1::bigint
  returning id
)
insert into lead_activities (lead_id, type, detail)
select id, 'resubmitted', jsonb_build_object('message', $2::text)
  from updated
returning lead_id

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: true, duplicate: true, leadId: $('Find Existing Lead').first().json.existing.id, status: $('Find Existing Lead').first().json.existing.status } }}

parameters.query:
with saved as (
  insert into leads (email, full_name, company, job_title, phone, message, source, utm,
                     category, score, intent, urgency, summary, classification_reasons, classified_by,
                     status, owner_email, opening, follow_up_step, next_follow_up_at)
  values ($1, $2, nullif($3, ''), nullif($4, ''), nullif($5, ''), nullif($6, ''), $7, $8::jsonb,
          $9, $10::int, $11, $12, $13, $14::jsonb, $15,
          $16, $17, nullif($19, ''),
          -- until the first email is confirmed, the lead is leased to the scheduler as a safety net
          -1, case when $16::text = 'new' then now() + interval '30 minutes' end)
  on conflict (email) do update
     set submission_count = leads.submission_count + 1,
         updated_at = now()
  returning *, (xmax = 0) as inserted
), logged as (
  insert into lead_activities (lead_id, type, detail)
  select id,
         case when inserted then 'created' else 'resubmitted' end,
         jsonb_build_object('category', category, 'score', score,
                            'classified_by', classified_by, 'fallback_reason', $18::text)
    from saved
)
select s.id, s.email, s.full_name, s.company, s.category, s.score, s.status,
       s.owner_email, s.response_token, s.inserted,
       t.subject as first_subject, t.body as first_body
  from saved s
  left join sequence_steps t on t.category = s.category and t.step = 0

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Validate & Normalize').first().json.lead.email, $('Validate & Normalize').first().json.lead.fullName, $('Validate & Normalize').first().json.lead.company, $('Validate & Normalize').first().json.lead.jobTitle, $('Validate & Normalize').first().json.lead.phone, $('Validate & Normalize').first().json.lead.message, $('Validate & Normalize').first().json.lead.source, JSON.stringify($('Validate & Normalize').first().json.lead.utm || {}), $json.classification.category, $json.classification.score, $json.classification.intent, $json.classification.urgency, $json.classification.summary, JSON.stringify($json.classification.reasons || []), $json.classification.classifiedBy, $json.status, $json.ownerEmail, $json.fallbackReason, $json.classification.opening] }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: true, leadId: $json.id, category: $json.category, score: $json.score, owner: $json.owner_email, classifiedBy: $('Finalize Classification').first().json.classification.classifiedBy } }}

parameters.query:
with updated as (
  update leads l
     set status = case when l.category = 'cold' then 'nurturing' else 'contacted' end,
         follow_up_step = 0,
         last_contacted_at = now(),
         next_follow_up_at = (select now() + s.delay_days::float8 * $2::interval
                                from sequence_steps s
                               where s.category = l.category and s.step = 1),
         updated_at = now()
   where l.id = $1::bigint
  returning l.id, l.next_follow_up_at
)
insert into lead_activities (lead_id, type, detail)
select id, 'email_sent', jsonb_build_object('step', 0, 'subject', $3::text, 'next_follow_up_at', next_follow_up_at)
  from updated
returning lead_id

with updated as (
  -- step -1 means "step 0 still to send": the scheduler retries it in 10 minutes
  update leads
     set follow_up_step = -1,
         next_follow_up_at = now() + interval '10 minutes',
         updated_at = now()
   where id = $1::bigint
  returning id
)
insert into lead_activities (lead_id, type, detail)
select id, 'email_failed', jsonb_build_object('step', 0, 'error', $2::text, 'retry_in', '10 minutes')
  from updated
returning lead_id

insert into lead_activities (lead_id, type, detail)
values ($1::bigint, $3::text, jsonb_build_object('to', $2::text, 'error', $4::text))

parameters.content:
## Lead intake
POST /webhook/lead with name, email, company, message.

1. Validate the form and check the optional shared secret
2. Skip leads that are already in the CRM
3. Classify with an LLM, or with rules if AI is off or fails
4. Save to the CRM and answer the form right away
5. Send the first reply and alert the owner of hot leads

## AI step
Any OpenAI-compatible API works (OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter, local Ollama). Set LLM_API_KEY, LLM_BASE_URL and LLM_MODEL.

Without a key the rule-based scorer runs instead, so the demo works offline.
